_schema: FactoryLab public observatory, v1. The only real data file the Progress page reads. A running world's public outputs (its wake page of sealed aggregates) are meant to feed it later. Publish aggregates and public facts only: never a seat's own scores, history or learner state, never a wallet address, account or order identifier, never a balance. Money is integer micro-USD. Times are ISO 8601 UTC. Pathology verdicts are present | absent | unknown. See site/README.md for every field.

status.headline: No world is live yet.
status.line: The factory is being built. Short rehearsal worlds have run on testnet and ended; the first long-lived world is still ahead. When it launches, this page follows it.
